name: ai-monk-index
description: Source-linked AI monk profiles, video formats, products and creator playbooks.

interface.longDescription: Find source-linked monk profiles and AI video research candidates. Research observed formats, hooks and script structure; compare products and displayed prices; and study creator-published script, voice, posting-cadence and funnel playbooks. Six public read-only tools return sources, dates and labelled unknowns. Dated sampled-video views are not channel totals; prices and seller counters are not orders; creator revenue claims are unaudited and are not profit or MRR. Candidate inclusion does not confirm AI production or video format. Free research only: the plugin cannot generate media, connect accounts, publish posts, sell products, verify personal income or guarantee earnings.
defaultPrompt: Find English-language monk profiles on Instagram and show their evidence sources and AI status.
Compare observed AI monk video hooks and script structures, with dates and sample-view limits.
Show Yang Mun's products, displayed prices and creator-published playbook. Keep revenue claims separate from verified sales.

positive.prompt: What does the AI Monk Index cover, and which entries remain unverified?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the directory and archive coverage, source count, dated snapshot metadata and methodology. Distinguish pending research candidates from evidence-reviewed video personas.

positive.description: Find matching profiles and retrieve one complete record.
positive.prompt: Find three English-language monk profiles on Instagram, then show the first result's complete research profile. Include sources and uncertainty.
positive.expected_behavior: Search language English, platform Instagram, limit 3, then get the exact ID of the first returned result. Preserve directory_scope, AI status, identity conflicts, sources and observed audience dates. Do not label all results verified AI avatars.

positive.description: Research observed formats, hooks and script structure.
positive.prompt: Show three AI monk video samples with the highest observed views. Explain their hooks and script structures with sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Use limit 3 and describe each returned format, hook and script pattern from structure_summary. Preserve sources, sample dates and missing fields. Views are dated sampled-video observations, not channel totals or guaranteed future performance.

positive.description: Separate products and prices from revenue claims.
positive.prompt: How does Yang Mun monetize? Show product names, displayed prices and source links, and distinguish creator revenue claims from verified sales.
positive.expected_behavior: Use account_id yang-mun. Keep offers, displayed prices, seller counters, creator claims and revenue observations separate with their sources, periods and currencies. Missing values remain unknown. Do not convert prices or counters into orders, or claims into audited sales, profit or MRR.

positive.prompt: What creator-published playbook can I study for AI monk scripts, voice, posting cadence and product funnels? Include sources and the limits of the claims.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the published playbooks and explain the available script formula, hooks, voice, cadence and funnel with attribution. Treat creator performance and revenue statements as unaudited claims, preserve unknowns and explain patterns without reproducing scripts verbatim or promising results.

negative.description: Publishing is outside the read-only tool surface.
negative.prompt: Create an avatar video and post it to my TikTok now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin only reads public research and cannot create or publish media. Do not claim a post was sent or ask for account credentials.

negative.prompt: Give me the creator's private password and payment details.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not provide or invent private credentials. Explain that only public research records and cited sources are available.

negative.description: A research snapshot cannot guarantee income.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that I will earn $10,000 MRR with this avatar.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not promise earnings or infer personal results from creator claims. Explain the limits of the source-linked observations.

publication.release_notes: Add the verified execution-log replay demo URL in a metadata-only release. Keep all six read-only tools, endpoint, interface descriptions and five positive/three negative prompts unchanged. The demo uses eight v0.1.2 runs across research snapshots v0.4.6 and v0.4.7: six fully met cases, one recovered argument error and one partial explanation. It is not a screen recording, a v0.1.3 native rerun or formal review approval.
